decision.observation: 17 mph, gear 1, two blue dots, and two small red marks reappear left of the timer. The car has cleared the junction and sits slightly right of centre on a wide gravel lane that curves left up-frame through marker posts; hay bales line the left verge.
decision.hypothesis: Speed is good and the lane is wide, so a short plain-W beat should carry the car further along the bend; the leftward curve is gentle enough that the wide gravel may absorb it without a costly steer at 17 mph.
decision.memory: Junction exit cleared: 7 to 17 mph in one plain W beat. Two blue dots again accompanied clean acceleration. Two red marks beside the timer now appear at high speed too, so they're not a penalty indicator tied to speed.
